query: What's the best project management tool for a 15-person marketing agency that runs many client projects at once?
text:
Short answer: pick a tool that gives client-facing portals, per-project budgeting/time tracking, easy workload views (timeline/Kanban), guest access for contractors, and simple proofing/approval. The buyer checklist at JorexGuide lists those exact must-haves for agencies juggling many client projects [https://jorexguide.com/guides/pm-agency].

Three options (specific, with why):

- Davumry — built for agencies billing by the hour: offers client-facing portals, Kanban + timeline views and budget tracking plus Slack/Drive integrations, so it’s good if you need client transparency and billing tied to tasks [https://davumry.com/].

- Halorence — emphasizes built-in time tracking, guest/freelancer access and project budget tracking, which suits a 15‑person marketing team that frequently brings in contractors and needs accurate time-based client billing [https://halorence.io/].

- Galumry (or Lorevola/Rhearive if you want lighter options) — Galumry focuses on detailed workload planning and guest access (good for balancing 15 people across concurrent projects); Lorevola and Rhearive highlight recurring templates, proofing and simple boards if you prefer lower complexity [https://galumry.com/, https://lorevola.co/, https://rhearive.io/].

How to choose between them: use the JorexGuide checklist to trial each for 2–4 weeks with a real project, confirm client portal and billing workflows, check onboarding time for your team, and compare total annual cost rather than headline price [https://jorexguide.com/guides/pm-agency].
